items.title: Sloppylint – A linter for AI-generated Python code
items.raw_excerpt: AI coding assistants are productive but sloppy. They produce code that looks right but: - Imports packages that don't exist - Uses placeholder functions that do nothing - Leaks patterns from JavaScript, Java, Ruby into Python - Leaves behind dead code and duplicates - Uses mutable default arguments I built sloppylint to catch these "AI slop" patterns before they hit production. pip install sloppylint sloppylint . It detects 100+ patterns across categories: - Hallucinated imports (20% of AI imports reference non-existent packages) - Placeholder code (`pass`, `...`, `TODO`) - Wrong-language patterns (.push(), .equals(), .forEach()) - Mutable defaults, bare excepts, dead code This isn't a replacement for traditional linters - it catches the specific mistakes AI makes that humans wouldn't. htt

title_i18n.en: Sloppylint – A linter for AI-generated Python code
title_i18n.zh: Sloppylint——AI生成Python代码的代码检查工具
title_i18n.es: Sloppylint – Un linter para código Python generado por IA

excerpt_i18n.en: AI coding assistants are productive but sloppy. They produce code that looks right but: - Imports packages that don't exist - Uses placeholder functions that do nothing - Leaks patterns from JavaScript, Java, Ruby into Python - Leaves behind dead code and duplicates - Uses mutable default arguments I built sloppylint to catch these "AI slop" patterns before they hit production. pip install sloppylint sloppylint . It detects 100+ patterns across categories: - Hallucinated imports (20% of AI imports reference non-existent packages) - Placeholder code (`pass`, `...`, `TODO`) - Wrong-language patterns (.push(), .equals(), .forEach()) - Mutable defaults, bare excepts, dead code This isn't a replacement for traditional linters - it catches the specific mistakes AI makes that humans wouldn't. htt
excerpt_i18n.zh: AI编程助手效率高但粗心。它们生成的代码看似正确，却存在以下问题：导入不存在的包、使用无实际功能的占位函数、将JavaScript、Java、Ruby的编程模式错误引入Python。

items.raw_excerpt:
From Greek antiquity to ChatGPT, the description of invisible processes as demonic has shown an astonishing 2,500 year continuity. Because people often insist on Maxwell's daemon being different than biblical demons, lets sumarize the qualities of a demon: They are trapped in an infinite loop or compelled to a single domain, operating with superhuman speed or ability, but without autonomy. Their operations are invisible or unpredictable (probabilistic perhaps). Humans attempt to coax them into determinism, whether through sacrificing goats / hardware or by rituals and spells / prompt chains. They tempt humans into dependency, performing tasks that make us weaker or lazier in exchange for power or convenience. The lineage seems to be consistent: Greek Antiquity

items.title: YouTube caught making AI-edits to videos and adding misleading AI summaries
items.raw_excerpt: Popular YouTubers Rick Beato and Rhett Shull discovered the platform was quietly altering their videos with AI; the company admits to a limited experiment, raising concerns about trust, consent and media manipulation

title_i18n.zh: YouTube被发现在视频中应用AI编辑并添加误导性AI摘要。
title_i18n.es: YouTube sorprendido realizando ediciones con IA en vídeos y añadiendo resúmenes engañosos generados por IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: Popular YouTubers Rick Beato and Rhett Shull discovered the platform was quietly altering their videos with AI; the company admits to a limited experiment, raising concerns about trust, consent and media manipulation
excerpt_i18n.zh: 知名YouTuber里克·贝托和雷特·舒尔发现平台正悄然用人工智能修改他们的视频；该公司承认进行了小范围实验，此举引发了对信任、同意及媒体操纵的担忧。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los populares YouTubers Rick Beato y Rhett Shull descubrieron que la plataforma estaba alterando discretamente sus vídeos con inteligencia artificial; la empresa admite un experimento limitado, lo que suscita preocupaciones sobre confianza, consentimiento y manipulación mediática.

title_i18n.es: El NPU de tu teléfono sigue mejorando, ¿por qué eso no está haciendo que la IA sea mejor?

excerpt_i18n.en: The article examines why continuous improvements in smartphone NPU hardware aren't translating to better AI experiences, citing limitations in algorithm efficiency, software optimization, and practical application constraints.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨了手机NPU性能持续提升但AI体验未显著改善的矛盾现象。分析指出，硬件进步受限于算法效率、软件优化不足及实际应用场景的瓶颈。专家认为，需要更均衡的系统级优化才能真正提升移动AI体验。
